dgu po gzhan ni rnam pa gnyis/ /zhes byung*/ rnam shes kyi khams bdun dang sems byung bcas brgyad po de dag rnams dang sgra dang dgu po chos can/ 'dir ma zin pa zhes bya ste/ zin ma zin ni gzugs can nang*/ phan tshun phrad pa las tshor ba bde sdug skyed mi skyed la 'jog pa gang zhig khyod rnams kyis de ltar skyed mi nus pa'i phyir/ sgra ma yin pa'i gzugs can gzhan dgu po ni chos can/ zin ma zin rnam pa gnyis yod de/ phan tshun phrad pa las bde sdug skyed nus mi nus gnyis kyi cha yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ reg bya rnam pa gnyis yin te/ lhag ma gzugs can dgu po ni/ 'byung gyur chos khams phyogs gcig kyang*/ /zhes byung*/ reg bya'i khams chos can/ khyod la 'byung ba dang 'byung gyur rnam pa gnyis yod pa yin te/ khyod la sa sogs 'byung ba bzhi dang*/ 'jam rtsub lci yang sogs 'byung gyur bdun yod pa'i phyir/ khams bco brgyad chos can/ khyod las 'byung 'gyur kho na yin pa yod de/ reg bya'i lhag ma gzugs can dgu dang*/ der ma zad chos khams kyi phyogs gcig kyang rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs ni 'byung gyur kho na yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ gzugs can bcu ni bsags pa'o/ /zhes byung*/ 'di la tshig don dang*/ mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni dbang don gyi gzugs can bcu chos can/ bsags pa zhes bya ste/ rdul phra rab 'dus pa'i gzugs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ kha cig /bsags rdul yin na/ rdzas rdul las che bas khyab zer na/ de mi 'thad par thal/ bsags rdul phra rab yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rang 'grel las/ thams cad pas phra ba'i gzugs ni gsags pa'i rdul phra rab ces bya ste/ de las chung ba ni mi mngon no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig /rdzas rdul brgyad 'dus pa'i gong bu de bsags rdul yin par thal/ rdzas rdul gnyis 'dus pa'i gong bu de bsags rdul gang zhig /bsags rdul de rdzas rdul brgyad dang lhan cig skyes pa'i phyir na ma khyab/

'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ de rdul rags pa yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rdzas rdul bdun 'dus pa'i gong bu de rdul rags pa yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig /rdul phra rab yin na/ rdul rags pa dang ma bcas pas khyab zer na/ bum pa'i cha shas su gyur pa'i rdul phra rab chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ bum pa de rdul phra rab bsags pa'i gong bu yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mi 'thad par thal/ bum pa'i cha shas yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig /du ma bsags pa'i rdul yin na/ bsags rdul yin pas khyab zer na/ rdul phra rab drug man bsags pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ rdul phra rab drug bsags pa'i de yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus so/ /bzhi pa ni/ gcod byed gcad par bya ba nyid/ /phyi rol gyi ni khams bzhi yin/ /de bzhin bsreg bya 'jal bya dang*/ /sreg dang gzhal la mi mthun smra/ /zhes byung*/ khams bco brgyad po de dag chos can/ khyod las gcod byed dang gcad par bya ba nyid kyi khyad par yod de/ sta re dang gri zor lta bu dang po dang*/ shing dang rtswa lta bu gnyis par grags pa'i gcod byed ni dbang po lnga dang sgra lta bu dang*/ gcad bya ni phyi rol gyi gzugs dri ro reg bya'i khams bzhi la 'jog pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du bsreg bya sreg byed dang 'jal bya 'jal byed kyi khyad par yod de/ dpe bsreg bya shing dang sreg byed me dang 'jal bya dngos po dang 'jal byed srang lta bu yang don snga ma ltar khams rnams kyi de'i steng nas 'jog pa'i phyir/ sreg dang gzhal ba la mi mthun par smra ba'i tshul yod de/ kha cig khams bzhi po nyid sreg byed dang gzhal bya gnyis kar 'dod cing*/ la la me kho na sreg byed dang lci ba kho na gzhal byar smra ba'i phyir/ lnga pa la byung ma byung gi sgo nas dbye ba/ phyi rang gi sgo nas/ rten bcas de mtshungs kyi sgo nas/ spang bya yin min gyi sgo nas dbye ba bzhi/ dang po la/ byung ba spyir bstan pa/

ma byung ba dmigs kyis bsal ba/ /dbang po dang rnam shes kyi sa mtshungs gsum/ dang po la/ rnam smin gyi rgyu/ rgyas byung gi rgyu/ rgyu mthun gyi rgyu gsum/ dang po ni/ rnam par smin las byung ba dang*/ zhes byung*/ bde 'gro ngan 'gro'i nang gi dbang po lnga chos can/ rnam par smin pa'i rgyu las byung ba yin te/ bde 'gro'i dbang po lnga ni dge ba zag bcas dang*/ ngan 'gro'i dbang po lnga ni mi dge ba las byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyas las byung ba nang gi lnga/ /sgra ni rnam smin las skyes min/ /zhes byung*/ nang gi dbang po lnga chos can/ rgyas pa las byung ba yod de/ kham zas zos pa dang*/ gnyid log pa dang*/ legs spyad sogs kyis dbang rten khog pa sogs rgyas pas dbang po lnga yang rgyas par byed pa'i phyir/ sgra chos can/ rnam smin gyi rgyu las skyais pa ma yin te/ smra ba po'i 'dod pa bzhin du byas chog pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ rgyu mthun las byung rnam smin skyes/ /thogs pa med brgyad gzhan rnam gsum/ zhes byung*/ thogs med kyi khams rnam shes bdun dang sems byung dang brgyad chos can/ rgyu mthun las byung ba dang rnam smin las skyes pa gnyis ka yod de/ skal mnyam dang kun 'gro'i rgyu las byung ba rnams ni rgyu mthun las byung ba yin la/ zag bcas kyi dge mi dge las byung ba ni rnam smin las byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan sgra ma gtogs pa'i gzugs dri ro reg bzhi chos can/ rgyas pa dang rnam smin dang rgyu mthun rnam pa gsum ga las skyes pa yod de/ rgyu mtshan gong du bshad cing 'chad par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rdzas dang ldan gcig tha ma gsum/ skad cig ma ste zhes byung*/ bye smra'i skabs 'dir rtag pa'i rdzas dang ldan pa'i chos khams gcig po chos can/ rgyu gsum gang rung las ma byung ste/ 'dus ma byas yin pa'i phyir/ sdug bsngal chos bzod skad cig ma dang po'i ngo bor gyur pa'i khams tha ma yid rnam shes chos gsum chos can/

rgyu mthun las byung ba yin te/ rang dang rigs 'dra ba'i zag med kyi khams sngon du ma song ba'i phyir te/ zag med dang po yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ mig dang ni/ rnam shes khams dag so so dang*/ lhan cig tu ni 'thob pa'ang yod/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ mig dbang dang mig gi rnam shes kyi khams dag 'thob tshul yod de/ gnyis ka so sor 'thob pa dang lhan cig tu ni 'thob pa'ang yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sas bsdus kyi mig dbang gsar du 'thob la/ rnam shes gsar du ma thob pa dang*/ de las bzlog pa/ gnyis ka thob pa/ gnyis ka ma thob pa dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ rtags rnams der thal/ gzugs med nas bsam gtan bzhi par skye ba'i tshe/ gzugs med na de gnyis ka med cing*/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i sas bsdus kyi mig yod kyang mig shes med/ bzhi pa nas dang por skye ba'i tshe bsam gtan dang po'i sas bsdus kyi gnyis ka yod/ gzugs med nas dang por skye ba'i tshe yang gnyis ka yod/ bsam gtan dang po nas gzugs med du skye ba'i tshe gzugs med na gnyis ka med pa'i phyir ro/ /der ma zad/ mig dbang dang de'i shes pa gnyis kyis gzugs la lta ba'i chos mtshungs yang mi 'dra ste/ 'dod pa'i rten can gyis bsam gtan dang po'i mig la brtan nas gzugs la lta ba'i tshe/ rten dbang po rnam shes rnams sas bsdus mi mtshungs pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de'i tshe rten 'dod pa'i sas bsdus/ gzhan gnyis bsam gtan dang po'i sas bsdus pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ nang gi bcu gnyis gzugs la sogs/ /ma gtogs zhes byung*/ nang gi khams chos can/ khyod la bcu gnyis yod de/ phyi'i gzugs la sogs pa yul gyi khams drug ma gtogs pa dbang po drug dang rnam shes drug po rnams de yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ chos zhes bya ba ste/ rten pa dang bcas lhag ma ni/ /de dang mtshungs pa dag kyang yin/ /gang zhig rang gi las mi byed/ /ces byung*/

chos zhes bya ba'i khams ni chos can/ mtha' gcig tu rten dang bcas pa yin te/ rnam shes kyi yul du mi 'gyur mi srid pa'i phyir/ lhag ma rnams ni chos can/ rten bcas dang de dang mtshungs pa dag kyang yod de/ khams gang zhig rang gi las byed bzhin pa rten bcas dang*/ las mi byed pa ni de mtshungs yin pa'i phyir/ dper na/ mig gis gzugs la lta ba dang mi lta ba'i skabs kyi khams bzhin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ bcu ni sgom pas spang bya yin/ /lnga yang tha ma gsum rnam gsum/ /nyon mongs can min mthong spang min/ /gzugs min drug pa min skyes min/ /zhes byung*/ gzugs can bcu ni chos can/ sgom pas spang bar bya ba yin te/ mthong spang min pa'i spang bya yin pa'i phyir/ zag bcas kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams lnga yang chos can/ sgom spang yin te/ rtags de'i phyir/ khams tha ma yid chos yid kyi rnam shes kyi khams gsum chos can/ khyod la rnam pa gsum yod de/ mthong spang sgom spang spang bya min pa gsum yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ nyon mongs can 'ga' zhig mthong spang*/ de min pa sngar bshad pa lta bu sgom spang*/ zag med kyi yid rnams de gang rung ma yin pa'i phyir/ so so'i skye bo chos can/ mthong spang min te/ nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs can bcu chos can/ mthong spang ma yin te/ gzugs yin pa'i phyir/ drug pa yid ches min pa dbang po gzugs can pa las skyes pa'i sgo lnga'i dbang shes chos can/ mthong spang min te/ yul bden pa la phyin ci log tu sgro 'dogs byed ma yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'dir mthong spang ni yul bden bzhi'i rnam pa ci rigs la phyin ci log tu sgro 'dogs pa'i nyon mongs can zhig la byed pa'i phyir/ drug pa la/ lta ba yin min gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ yul du 'gyur tshul gyi sgo nas/ rtag mi rtag gi sgo nas/ dbang po yin min gyi sgo nas dbye ba bzhi/ dang po la/ spyir bstan pa/

mig lta bar sgrub pa/ dbang po'i khyad chos gsum/ dang po ni/ mig dang chos kyi khams phyogs ni/ /lta ba yin te rnam pa brgyad/ /rnam shes lnga dang mtshungs skyes blo/ /nges rtog med phyir lta ma yin/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ lta ba dang lta min gyi khyad par yod de/ mig dang chos khams kyi phyogs gcig lta ba lnga dang 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba dang slob mi slob kyi gnyis te rnam pa brgyad po lta ba yin la/ lhag ma phyed dang bcu bdun lta ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes lnga dang mtshungs ldan du skyes pa'i blo shes rab nyon mongs can chos can/ yang dag pa'i lta ba ma yin te/ nges rtog ming don 'dzin pa'i yang dag pa'i rtog pa'i ngo bor med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ dbang shes yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ mig gis gzugs rnams mthong rten bcas/ /de la brten pa'i rnam shes min/ /gang phyir bar du chod pa yi/ /gzugs ni mthong ba min phyir lo/ /mig ni gnyis ka dag gis kyang*/ /mthong ste gsal bar mthong phyir ro/ /zhes byung*/ mig chos can/ lta ba yin te/ gzugs rnams mthong byed yin pa'i phyir/ /mig gis gzugs mthong ba ni rten dbang po dang bcas shing de la rag las pa yin gyi/ de la brten pa'i rnam shes kho nas mthong ba min te/ rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir de kho nas mthong na bar du chod pa'i gzugs rnams kyang mthong dgos pa las/ de ni mthong ba min pa'i phyir/ lo zhes smos pa la chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ mig dbang tsam gyis gzugs mthong ba dgag pa'i ched du yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs chos can/ mig gcig gis mthong yang khyad par yod de/ mig ni gnyis ka dag gis kyang gsal bar mthong bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ dbang pos yul 'dzin tshul/ dbang po rten du 'gyur tshul/ sa gang du gtogs pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mig dang yid dang rna ba ni/ /yul dang ma phrad gsum gzhan du/ sna la sogs pa gsum gyis ni/

/ yul ni mnyam par 'dzin par 'dod/ /zhes byung*/ mig dang yid dang rna ba gsum ni chos can/ rang gi yul dang ma phrad par 'dzin pa yin te/ mig gis rgyang ring po'i gzugs mthong*/ rna bas rgyang ring po'i sgra thos/ yid kyis dus gsum ka yul du byed pas 'phrad mi dgos pa'i phyir/ sna la sogs pa gsum ni chos can/ ma phrad pa las gzhan du 'phrad nas 'dzin pa yin te/ khyod gsum gyis ni rang dang mnyam pa'i yul 'dzin par 'dod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ lces rang dang phrad pa'i ro'i rdul 'dzin gyi/ ma phrad par mi 'dzin/ de bzhin du sna dang lus kyis kyang phrad pa'i yul 'dzin gyi/ ma phrad pa mi 'dzin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ tha ma'i rten 'das lnga rnams kyi/ /de dag lhan cig skyes pa'ang yin/ /de dag gyur pas 'gyur nyid phyir/ /rten ni mig la sogs pa yin/ /de phyir thun mong ma yin phyir/ /de dag gis ni rnam shes bstan/ /zhes byung*/ khams tha ma yin gyi rnam shes chos can/ khyod kyi rten du dus gsum ga med de/ rang dus na 'das pa'i yid kyi bdag rkyen kho na la brten nas skyes pa'i phyir/ dbang po'i rnam shes lnga rnams chos can/ khyod kyi bdag rkyen la gnyis yod de/ rang dus su 'das pa dang da lta ba gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ dbang po de dag rang dang lhan cig tu skyes pa'ang yin pa'i phyir/ mig la sogs pa dbang po lnga po de dag chos can/ rang gi rnam shes kyi rten yin te/ dbang po de dag gsal mi gsal du gyur pa las rnam shes dag kyang gsal mi gsal du 'gyur ba nyid kyi phyir/ rten dbang po lnga po de dag gi ming gis ni brten pa rang rang gi rnam shes kyang bstan pa yin te/ mig sogs dbang po lnga po de rang rang gi rnam shes so so'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ mig rna ba sna lce lus kyi rnam shes zhes pa'i tha snyad ni rang rang gi bdag rkyen thun mong ma yin pa dbang po'i sgo nas brjod kyi/

thun mong ba'i bdag rkyen gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i sgo nas ma yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ lus la 'og ma'i mig ma yin/ /mig gis gong ma'i gzugs ma yin/ /rnam par shes pa'ang de yi gzugs/ /lus kyi 'ang gnyis ka thams cad du/ /rna ba'ang de bzhin gsum dag ni/ /thams cad rang gi sa pa nyid/ /lus kyi rnam shes 'og dang ni/ /rang gi sa yi ma nges te/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ sa gong ma'i lus la sa 'og ma'i mig skye ba ma yin te/ gong ma'i lus kyis 'og ma'i mig las mchog tu gyur pa rang sa'i mig gi rten byed pa'i phyir/ sa 'og ma'i mig gis gong ma'i gzugs mthong ba min te/ 'og ma'i mig dman cing*/ gong ma'i gzugs mchog yin pas yul du byed mi nus pa'i phyir dang*/ 'og ma'i mig gis gong ma'i rnam par shes pa'i rten mi byed pa'ang de dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ rnam shes de yi yul la sa gsum ka'i gzugs ni yod de/ bsam gtan dang po bas bzhi pa'i mig thob pa'i tshe rnam shes kyis rang sa dang po/ /'og sa 'dod pa/ gong sa bzhi pa'i gzugs yul du byed pa'i phyir/ lus kyi 'ang rnam shes dang yul gnyis ka sa gsum du gtogs pa yod de/ snga ma dang 'dra zhing*/ rna ba'ang de bzhin du sbyor rigs pa'i phyir/ sna lce lus kyi rnam par shes pa gsum po dag ni chos can/ dbang rten yul dang bcas pa thams cad rang gi sa bar spyir mtshungs pa nyid yin la 'on kyang ma nges te/ lus kyi rnam shes ni 'og sar gtogs pa yod cing*/ rang gi sar gtogs pa ni 'dod pa dang bsam gtan dang po na yod pa'i phyir/ yid kyi rnam shes chos can/ rang yul dang sa mtshungs par ma nges te/ sa gong 'og thams cad kyi gzugs yul du byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gnyis kyi rnam shes phyi yi lnga/ /zhes byung*/ phyi'i gzugs sogs skye mched lnga chos can/ rnam shes gnyis gnyis kyi yul du 'gyur ba yod de/ mig gi rnam shes sogs lnga dang yid shes kyi yul du'ang 'gyur ba'i phyir/

gsum pa ni/ 'dus ma byas chos rtag pa'o/ /zhes byung*/ 'dus ma byas kyi chos chos can/ rtag pa yin te/ mi 'jig pa'i chos yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ chos kyi phyed dang gang dag ni/ bcu gnyis nang gir bshad dbang ngo*/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ dbang po yin min gyi khyad par yod de/ chos kyi phyed tshor ba bde ba sogs lnga dang*/ dad pa'i dbang po sogs lnga dang*/ rnam byang gi dbang po gsum ste bcu gsum dang*/ khams gang dag mig sogs nang gi khams su bshad pa bcu gnyis ni dbang po yin la/ de las gzhan pa rnams dbang por ma bshad pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ chos mngon pa mdzod kyi tshig le'ur byas pa khams bstan pa zhes bya ba ste gnas dang po legs par bshad pa yin te/ tshig don gyi sgo nas legs par bshad pa'i phyir ro// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/mdzod gnas dang po'i ṭīk+ka 'phags tshogs thams cad kyi dgongs don bzhugs/ -PAGE 66--PAGE 67--PAGE 1-
